import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import requests

# Fetch papers from arXiv API
url = "http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:multimodal+RAG&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending&max_results=5"
response = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
xml_content = response.content.decode('utf-8')

# Parse XML
root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

papers = []
for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
    paper = {
        'id': entry.find('atom:id', ns).text,
        'title': entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip().replace('\n', ' '),
        'summary': entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip().replace('\n', ' '),
        'published': entry.find('atom:published', ns).text,
        'updated': entry.find('atom:updated', ns).text,
        'authors': [],
        'categories': []
    }
    
    # Extract authors
    for author in entry.findall('atom:author', ns):
        name = author.find('atom:name', ns)
        if name is not None:
            paper['authors'].append(name.text.strip())
    
    # Extract categories
    for cat in entry.findall('atom:category', ns):
        paper['categories'].append(cat.get('term'))
    
    papers.append(paper)

# Generate markdown
md = "# Multimodal RAG Papers\n\n"
md += "## Comparison Table\n\n"
md += "| # | Title | Authors | Published | Categories | Summary |\n"
md += "|---|-------|---------|-----------|------------|---------|\n"

for i, p in enumerate(papers, 1):
    summary = p['summary'][:200] if len(p['summary']) > 200 else p['summary']
    title = p['title'][:100] if len(p['title']) > 100 else p['title']
    authors_str = ', '.join(p['authors'])[:50] if p['authors'] else 'N/A'
    cats_str = ', '.join(p['categories'])[:30] if p['categories'] else 'N/A'
    md += f"| {i} | {title} | {authors_str} | {p['published'][:10]} | {cats_str} | {summary}... |\n"

with open('papers.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(md)

print(f"Wrote {len(papers)} papers to papers.md")
